long_biography.plain_text:
Mykola Udianskyi sold his payment-terminal network in 2014, securing his first major business proceeds. He then moved to Thailand, joined exchange developers and helped build six trading platforms while accumulating digital assets.

Coinsbit was the first exchange Udianskyi created for his own ownership instead of a client. He sold a stake in 2019 and later applied the platform-building model to Qmall. This progression from payment hardware to exchange software established digital infrastructure and cryptocurrency holdings as the core of his business activity. Property became a secondary destination for part of the proceeds.
